facts.value: Not 远瀛观's wings: those are inside B0096's 5 bays (two end pavilions with clock roofs on plate 14). A low service range on the north wall, 40 m behind the hall on the plan, turning south at the end. No plate shows it. Under today's tree row and path north of the fence; the excavation of 2016 is not known to me to have reached it. (S01, Round 6).
